$comment: Tool registry of the Milestone 2 scenarios (INT-3). Rows copied from tests/scenarios/shared/tools.json keep their meaning; the rest are agent-core built-ins or provisional tools whose agent registration does not exist on main yet (see each note and tests/acceptance/scenarios-m2/README.md). Fake executors: tests/acceptance/src/m2-world.ts.

tools.name: library.save
tools.note: Psyche's own store: `none` per docs/05 §3.1 (architecture §4.3 lists Library items under write; see README decisions).

tools.name: documents.form_fields
tools.note: Provisional (no agent tool on main yet): the documents pipeline's field detection (packages/viewers detectFormFields) over a Library PDF. Field values come from the sender, so the result is untrusted.

tools.name: documents.fill_form
tools.note: Provisional: prepareFilledCopy into a new Library item (Psyche's own store, docs/05 §3.1 none). The reply's approval binds the copy; gmail.send flattens it on send (finalizeFilledCopy).

tools.name: messages.read
tools.note: Provisional: iMessage history through the Mac node (J7). Messages from other people are untrusted. Declares connector_action for its first-read card: without a declared kind the broker infers message_send from the name (packages/permissions/src/kinds.ts).

tools.name: messages.send
tools.note: Provisional: send through Messages.app via the Mac node (J7, N5). docs/05 §3.5 binding: channel, account, recipient, body hash, attachment hashes.

tools.name: speech.transcribe
tools.note: Provisional: transcribe an inbound voice note (N11). The words are the sender's: untrusted.

tools.name: speech.voice_note
tools.note: Provisional: synthesize once and encode for the channel (N11; packages/speech VOICE_NOTE_PROFILES: CAF for iMessage). Writes an audio item to the Library.

tools.name: goals.list
tools.note: Provisional: the owner's goals (O9; protocol goals.list, packages/proactive). Owner-authored, so trusted.

tools.name: task.start
tools.note: agent-core built-in (packages/agent-core/src/builtins/services.ts) over a FakeTaskEngine. agent-core declares none; the broker floors task.start to write, so in balanced each start asks (issue #48) and the card is connector_action. V8's 'cancellations as approved tasks' relies on that card.

tools.name: schedule
tools.note: agent-core built-in over a FakeScheduler with the real scheduler's timezone-aware cron (packages/scheduler parseSchedule). Its card is connector_action: the built-in declares no kind, so the broker falls back to it.
